text: E417 alarm every afternoon even with clean fan and good sensor. Root cause: electrical cabinet air conditioner failed, enclosure above 45 degrees C. Resolution: repaired cabinet AC and added a temperature check to the weekly round.
Pump grinding again. Replacement impeller ordered, vendor contact Suresh at +91 98765 43210 for delivery update.
CONV-02 drive motor is behind the packing line fence. Access needs the fence key from security cabin 3 and a line stop permit.
Weekly inspection of PRESS-04 completed. Oil level normal, no leaks found.
Tension the belt to 1.5 percent elongation measured between marks 1 m apart. 1 percent was not enough for loaded belts and they slipped with alarm C050. Recheck tension after 48 hours of running.
Compressor pressure not building but unloader valve tested fine. Root cause: cracked air line fitting behind the dryer. Resolution: replaced fitting, pressure normal.
Possible early bearing wear on PUMP-12, slight noise at startup. Not confirmed, needs a vibration check.
Tension the belt to 1 percent elongation measured between marks 1 m apart. Recheck tension after 24 hours instead of 48, belts on CONV-05 loosened within a day.
